name: Sweet Parallax Card
description: Rounded showcase card with a large title behind a cut-out product image, soft progressive blur at the bottom, and layered parallax that follows the mouse or device tilt.
contents: Card with background photo, big outlined title, floating hero product image
Location line with pin icon and a subtitle over a progressive blur
behavior: Background, title and hero image shift at different depths following mouse position
On touch devices the first tap enables device orientation tilt, asking permission on iOS
Progressive blur built from five masked backdrop-blur layers
editableByProps: Title, location, subtitle, both images and alt text
Card size, aspect ratio, corner radius and backdrop gradient classes
Hero image size and parallax strength

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blur strength or falloff

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Listens to window mousemove and click for the parallax and resets them on unmount
Root disables touch scrolling and text selection (touch-none)
Uses Bebas Neue and Rubik through next/font/google
